title: Median sold prices by postcode district and year, England and Wales

method: Category A (standard price paid) sales only, by transfer date, one row per postcode district, calendar year and split (a split is one grouping at a time: all sales, one property type, one tenure, or new-build or existing; they are not crossed). Medians and quartiles (inclusive method) in whole pounds, nominal and not adjusted for inflation; null when a year has fewer than 5 sales (a quality threshold: every sale is already published by HM Land Registry). Rows with no sales are left out. Only complete calendar years are shown, and the latest year is as at the month the file was built; sales registered later are added when the file is next rebuilt (when a new year is complete or the postcode release changes). Districts are those current in the ONS Postcode Directory release named in the file. Not an index: the mix of homes sold changes from year to year.
